classification: exact-moment analytic feasibility scan; not sampled or formal evidence

analysis.primary_risk: mean personalized terminal parameter mean-square error
analysis.strong_fixed: cellwise best registered alpha with no sensing cost
analysis.two_phase_oracle: cellwise best registered early/late alpha pair with the frozen switch and no sensing cost
analysis.safe_oracle: recipient-wise exact checkpoint risk minimizer relative to the fully charged local shadow
analysis.no_probe_local: alpha zero with every transition used for learning

mandatory_gates.P1: all 648 cells and 27864 policy rows are finite
mandatory_gates.P2: zero mixing is byte-level moment equivalent to the same-data local shadow
mandatory_gates.P3: the safe oracle is no worse than its charged shadow at every agent checkpoint
mandatory_gates.P4: all policies satisfy exact environment and message budgets; safe probes are never learning updates
mandatory_gates.P5: the two-phase oracle improves aggregate geometric terminal risk over the strong fixed alpha by at least 5%
mandatory_gates.P6: the two-phase oracle strictly improves at least 50% of cells
mandatory_gates.P7: the fully charged safe oracle improves aggregate geometric risk over the strong fixed alpha by at least 3%
mandatory_gates.P8: the fully charged safe oracle strictly improves at least 40% of cells
mandatory_gates.P9: safe-oracle aggregate risk is no worse than no-probe local and its cellwise ratio is at most 1.05 in at least 95% of cells
mandatory_gates.P10: among cells using nonzero transfer, at least 40% have larger mean early than late mixing
mandatory_gates.P11: safe-oracle selected actions contain at least four distinct alpha values and both shadow fallback states
